feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 309 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Android Data Safety Checker — permissions/SDKs vs Play Console declaration
entry.summary: Free, browser-local checker: scans your AndroidManifest.xml permissions and Gradle dependencies for known analytics/ads/crash SDKs, and compares them against the Data safety categories you say you've already declared in Play Console -- so a missed declaration doesn't cost you a policy warning or listing removal. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Asbestos Abatement Bid Calculator — Containment-Class Pricing
entry.summary: Free bid calculator for licensed asbestos abatement contractors: price a removal job by OSHA/EPA containment class (I/II/III), square footage, crew and supervisor rates, air monitoring, and waste disposal — and see the gap against a flat rate per square foot.

entry.title: Biohazard Cleanup Bid Calculator — Trauma & Crime-Scene Job Pricing
entry.summary: Free calculator for biohazard and trauma-scene remediation technicians: price a job from crew labor, PPE decon cycles, and regulated-waste disposal billed per container (not per pound), then check whether a quote you're already giving clears cost.

entry.title: Branch Protection Drift Check — Does Your Repo Still Match Its Own Policy?
entry.summary: Paste a repo's actual GitHub branch protection settings (gh api branches/:branch/protection) and your declared policy to find every rule that has drifted weaker than intended — a temporarily disabled review requirement, force pushes turned back on, admin enforcement quietly off. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Call Recording Consent Check — One-Party or All-Party by State
entry.summary: Pick the caller's and recipient's US states and get an instant one-party vs. all-party call-recording consent determination, the exact statute cited, and a ready-to-read disclosure script for your call opening. Free, deterministic, runs entirely in your browser — not legal advice.

entry.title: Deploy Concurrency Check — find the race that ships an older commit
entry.summary: Paste a GitHub Actions workflow and see every way it is allowed to apply an older revision over a newer one: no concurrency group, a group that changes every run, cancel-in-progress on a deploy, split groups on one environment, and a checkout of a moving branch. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Dog Boarding & Daycare Pricing Calculator — Price a Stay, Check Occupancy
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent dog boarding and daycare facility owners: price a reservation from staff time, supplies, overhead, a long-stay discount, and a multi-dog discount, then check whether your kennel/run occupancy clears a monthly break-even.

entry.title: Estate Sale Net Proceeds Calculator — Compare Company Quotes
entry.summary: Free calculator for estate sale commission quotes. Enter a company's tiered commission rates, setup fee, card-processing fee, and haul-away fee against your estimated sale total to see the real net proceeds — and compare two companies' quotes side by side. Nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Helm Values Schema Check — Find a values.yaml Typo Helm Won't
entry.summary: Paste a Helm chart's values.yaml and its values.schema.json and get a deterministic report of every field values.yaml sets that the schema does not declare (Helm's template engine never errors on this -- it silently returns no value), every schema-required field missing from values.yaml, and every type, enum, or min/max mismatch. Free, runs entirely in your browser, no Helm binary needed, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Import Landed Cost Calculator — Duty, Tariff & Customs Fee Breakdown
entry.summary: Free landed cost calculator for small e-commerce importers: enter your item cost, freight, duty rate, and Section 301/supplemental tariff rate to see total landed cost, cost per unit, and your real tariff burden as a percent of the invoice price — with Merchandise Processing Fee and Harbor Maintenance Fee priced from CBP's published schedule.

entry.title: Kubernetes Deprecated API Check — Find Manifests a Cluster Upgrade Will Reject
entry.summary: Paste or load Kubernetes manifest YAML and get a deterministic report of every apiVersion + kind pair a past or future Kubernetes release has removed or will remove -- extensions/v1beta1 Ingress, batch/v1beta1 CronJob, policy/v1beta1 PodSecurityPolicy, and more -- so a platform team catches the manifest before a rolling upgrade fails on it, not during it. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: OpenAPI Breaking Change Check — Did This API Version Break Existing Clients?
entry.summary: Paste two OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON documents and see exactly which changes would break an existing client — a removed endpoint, a parameter that became required, a narrowed type, a removed enum value. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Podcast Sponsorship Rate Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free podcast sponsorship rate calculator. Enter your average downloads per episode, niche, and read type to get a price range for a pre-roll, mid-roll, and post-roll ad spot — based on commonly cited podcast-ad-market CPM benchmarks. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Propane Delivery Route Margin Calculator — Price Each Customer
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent propane (LP gas) delivery route operators: find real annual profit per customer after the retail/wholesale price spread, the minimum-delivery fee on small fills, drive time and mileage, and tank rental and hazmat compliance cost, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

entry.title: Required Checks Drift Check — Is a Branch Protection Check Stuck Forever?
entry.summary: Paste your branch protection required status checks and your GitHub Actions workflow YAML to find every required check name no job can ever report again — the reason a pull request sits at 'Expected — Waiting for status to be reported' forever. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: StockX Seller Payout Calculator — Net Profit After All Fees
entry.summary: Free calculator for StockX sneaker, streetwear, and card sellers: find real net payout and net profit after the seller fee (which drops by seller level), the Fast Shipping discount, the payment processing fee, and outbound shipping cost, then check a month of sales against a profit goal.

entry.title: Storage Auction Max Bid Calculator — What the Cost Stack Actually Supports
entry.summary: Free calculator for storage-unit auction bidders: prices the buyer's premium, realistic resale recovery, resale fees, dump and labor cost, and holding cost, then reports the bid a target margin supports, the break-even bid, and what a flat percent-of-value rule of thumb would have told you to bid instead.

entry.title: Subpath Robots Check — Is Your GitHub Pages Sitemap Ever Read?
entry.summary: A site published at a URL subpath — user.github.io/repo/, gitlab.io/project/, a CDN subdirectory — cannot govern its own robots.txt, so its sitemap is never auto-discovered and its pages are never enumerated. Paste your site URL to find out. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Tutor Package Pricing Calculator — Package vs. Pay-Per-Session, Free
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent tutors and coaches: compares a discounted prepaid session package against pay-per-session pricing on effective hourly pay, not just revenue — the package discount can quietly cost more per hour than it saves once missed sessions are made up. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Twitch Payout Calculator — Real Take-Home From Subs and Bits
entry.summary: Free calculator for Twitch streamers: find real monthly take-home from Tier 1/2/3 subs (50% standard or 70% Partner Plus split) and Bits, see whether a mobile subscription really pays less (it doesn't), and check how many more subs close a monthly income gap.

entry.title: Vector Database Cost Calculator (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector)
entry.summary: Estimate your embedding index's real storage footprint from vector count, dimension, and metadata, then compare monthly cost across up to three vector database providers using their own quoted rates. Free, private, no signup.

entry.title: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md Drift Check — Broken Links & Footguns in Agent Instructions
entry.summary: Paste your AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or copilot-instructions.md and see every file path it references that no longer exists, every npm run script it names that isn't defined, and known interpreter-mismatch shell footguns (bare pytest/mypy instead of python3 -m). Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Backflow Test Fee Calculator — Multi-Device Job Quote, Free
entry.summary: Free backflow-preventer test fee calculator: per-device test fee with a multi-device discount, a per-device report-filing fee, a travel fee, and a retest fee for failed devices. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Bridal Hair & Makeup Pricing Calculator — Total, Balance Due & Assistant Check
entry.summary: Free calculator for bridal hair and makeup artists: price the bride, bridal party, hair-only, makeup-only, and kids' services, apply an early-start fee and travel, top up to your service minimum, and check whether the group fits in one artist's schedule before the ceremony — or needs a second artist billed and paid as its own line item.

entry.title: Commissary Kitchen Cost Split Calculator — Bill Tenants Fairly
entry.summary: Free calculator for commissary/shared-kitchen operators: split pooled monthly costs (rent, utilities, trash, cleaning, pest control, insurance) fairly among multiple food-truck tenants by hours booked and storage used, instead of splitting evenly, and get an itemized bill for each tenant.

entry.title: Cron DST Drift Check — Will This Schedule Skip, Double-Fire, or Drift?
entry.summary: Paste a cron expression and an IANA timezone and see every upcoming run that falls in a spring-forward gap (never happens) or a fall-back overlap (happens twice), plus a separate check for how a fixed-UTC-only scheduler (GitHub Actions' schedule: cron included) drifts an hour twice a year against your intended local time. Free, deterministic, runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: HOA Reserve Fund Calculator — Special Assessment Risk
entry.summary: Free calculator for HOA/condo board treasurers: project whether your current reserve contribution covers known roof, repaving, painting, pool, elevator, and HVAC replacements, or find the year a special assessment hits, then solve the minimum contribution to avoid it.

entry.title: Land Survey Bid Calculator — Corner-Based Pricing
entry.summary: Free bid calculator for independent licensed land surveyors: price a boundary, topographic, or ALTA/NSPS survey by corners located vs. set, terrain, record research, crew and drafting time — and see the gap against a flat per-acre quote.

entry.title: Overtime Pay Calculator — Blended Rate for Two Pay Rates, Free
entry.summary: Free overtime pay calculator: standard time-and-a-half for one hourly rate, plus the FLSA weighted-average (blended rate) calculator for a week worked at two or more different pay rates. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: PDF Accessibility Tag Checker — Free PDF/UA & Section 508 Evidence, Nothing Uploaded
entry.summary: Free tool: drop a PDF in your browser and get an evidence report on tagging, title, language, image alt text, and form-field labels -- the structural checks behind PDF/UA and Section 508. The file never leaves your device. Also a zero-dependency CLI for batch-scanning a whole document library.

entry.title: Photo Package Add-On Pricing Calculator
entry.summary: Free calculator for independent wedding and event photographers: find real net profit for one package add-on -- an extra hour, a second shooter, an album upgrade, an engagement session -- after your own shoot/cull/edit time, gear wear, and any subcontractor or physical-goods cost, then compare two or three add-ons by effective hourly rate.

entry.title: SBOM Diff Check — What Changed Between Two CycloneDX or SPDX Builds?
entry.summary: Paste two CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM JSON files and see exactly which packages were added, removed, or changed version between two builds. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: security.txt Checker — Is Your RFC 9116 File Valid, or Expired?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste a security.txt and check it against RFC 9116 — a missing or expired Expires field (the one that silently makes your whole file stale), a Contact that isn't a URI, a plain-http Contact, a PGP key pasted where an Encryption URI belongs, a duplicated Expires or Preferred-Languages, the British spelling of Acknowledgments, and a signed file with no Canonical. Runs in your browser or as a zero-dependency Node CLI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: SQL Migration Lock Check — Will This Migration Take Your Database Down?
entry.summary: Paste a PostgreSQL migration and find every statement that can lock the table and stall your app: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY, ALTER COLUMN TYPE, SET NOT NULL, a foreign key without NOT VALID, and a missing lock_timeout that turns a millisecond change into an outage. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded, no database connection.

entry.title: Wedding Florist Proposal Calculator — Bunch Rounding, Labour & Margin
entry.summary: Free calculator for wedding and event florists: price a proposal from the recipe up, buying whole bunches instead of loose stems, add a shrink allowance before the rounding, price labour by the hour, and see the gross margin — plus what a per-stem markup sheet would have under-quoted.

entry.title: World Clock & Daylight — Time, Sunrise, Sunset and Who's Awake
entry.summary: A free world clock that shows current local time, sunrise, sunset, daylight length and whether each city is awake — for as many cities as you like, side by side. Sunrise and sunset are computed in your browser from the US Naval Observatory almanac algorithm. No account, no upload, no API key.

entry.title: Caption Quality Checker — SRT & WebVTT Reading Speed, Line Length & Timing
entry.summary: Free tool: paste an SRT or WebVTT caption file and check it against commonly-used caption style-guide thresholds -- reading speed (characters per second), line length, lines per cue, minimum/maximum duration, overlapping cues, and too-short gaps between cues. A zero-dependency CLI runs the same checks in your own CI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Court Reporter Transcript Pricing Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free deposition transcript pricing calculator for freelance court reporters: turn page count, turnaround, travel, copies, and exhibits into an invoice total and an effective hourly rate, and check whether an agency's flat offer is worth the day. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Obsidian Plugin Review Checker — Manifest, versions.json & Security Patterns
entry.summary: Free, browser-local checker for Obsidian plugin developers: cross-checks manifest.json against versions.json, flags leftover sample-plugin template placeholder values, and scans source for innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML -- the patterns behind common Obsidian community plugin review delays. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Repair or Replace? Work Truck & Equipment Planner for Small Fleets
entry.summary: Free browser planner for trade and service fleets: cost out repair-versus-replace for every van, truck and machine including the downtime days most owners leave out, then rank which ones to replace against a fixed capital budget. Nothing uploaded.
